_provenance: Shape: OpenAPI certificates/models/certificate.yml (spec): id, name, not_after, sha1_fingerprint, created_at, dns_names, state (pending/verified/error), type (custom/lets_encrypt). A create takes name and type, plus dns_names (lets_encrypt) or private_key, leaf_certificate and certificate_chain (custom) (spec, certificate_create.yml). Let's Encrypt certificates are issued only for names in a domain DigitalOcean hosts (docs). Whether names are unique per account, and the 422 text of a certificate a load balancer still uses, are unverified. Values are illustrative.
